title: RC6 provider-neutral selection provider: frozen candidates, immediate mechanical columns, closed-form experience weights, Pareto frontier with equivalence-band seeded variety.

supersedes.reason: A fully deterministic frontier tie-break cannot satisfy the variety requirement: different battle experiences must approach the appropriate choice and must not always repeat the same move. The supersede is limited to the final selection among in-band non-dominated candidates; margin-protected unique optima stay deterministic.

inherits: SelectionPolicyV1: every clause except candidateTieBreak within the Pareto frontier
ExecutionContractV31: providerStateMachine, modes, productionBoundary, gateCatalog, qualityGate, worktreePolicy, rollbackPolicy
authority.conflictRule: Inherited clauses remain authoritative unless this contract states a stricter execution gate or the explicit supersede scope above. Experience, random facts and proof requirements are defined by this contract itself and are not inherited from ExecutionContractV31.

allowed.name: frozenCandidates
allowed.description: Current legal action candidates enumerated from public state; each candidate carries its own immediate mechanical columns and identity.

allowed.name: immediateMechanicalColumns
allowed.description: The public column set per candidate defined in immediateMechanicalColumns; current turn only, no future construction.

allowed.name: publicBelief
allowed.description: Declared public belief fields: belief_prior_strength, confidence, uncertainty_width; sources are PUBLIC_DECLARED only.

allowed.name: battleIntentAndObjectives
allowed.description: battleIntent mode and objectives as declared public inputs.

allowed.name: experience
allowed.description: Deterministic vector e=(p,q,u) derived from publicBelief by this contract's experience section; never random, never teacher, never hidden.

allowed.name: seededRandomFact
allowed.description: One declared seeded random fact per selection: seed (64 hex) and actualValue in [0,1) declared by upstream; consumed only when the equivalence band has at least two members.

forbidden.name: teacherOutput
forbidden.description: No teacher suggestion, override or choice may enter selection.

forbidden.name: precomputedHEPP
forbidden.description: S1-S6 are computed from immediate mechanical columns by this provider; precomputed HEPP vectors are not consumed.

forbidden.name: route
forbidden.description: No future route, branch enumeration or horizon data may enter selection.

forbidden.name: future
forbidden.description: No future state, future action or forecast may enter selection.

forbidden.name: resultWorld
forbidden.description: No result world or outcome enumeration may enter selection.

forbidden.name: kernelRouteValue
forbidden.description: No kernel route value, route-reuse value or prototype path value may enter selection or S4.

forbidden.name: hiddenState
forbidden.description: Hidden HP, resistance, inventory or unobserved posterior never enters selection.

forbidden.name: wallClock
forbidden.description: No wall-clock time or nondeterministic source may enter selection.

components.name: resultProxy
components.formula: clamp(u * revealStrength * clamp((declaredEffectHigh - declaredEffectLow) / refSpread, 0, 1), 0, capS4)

s4Proxy.u: u = uncertainty_width from publicBelief, clamped to [0, 1]; default 1 when the declared field is missing
s4Proxy.immediateOnly: S4 uses only declaredEffectLow, declaredEffectHigh, revealStrength and u; it is a strict current-turn proxy and never consumes kernel route values, route-reuse values or prototype path values

closedForm: w3 = a3 * (1 + gamma * p + gammaPrime * q)

selectionSemantics.frontier: F = nondominated subset of L over the six policy dimensions (direction-aware exact dominance); exact-duplicate vectors collapse to one class
selectionSemantics.optimal: c* = argmax_{c in F} S(c); S ties broken by candidateId UTF-16 code unit ascending
selectionSemantics.margin: m = S(c*) - max_{c in F, c != c*} S(c); a single-member frontier gives m = +infinity
selectionSemantics.marginRule: m > epsilon => V = {c*} and the pick is deterministic; m <= epsilon => the equivalence band applies
selectionSemantics.equivalenceBand: V = {c in F : S(c) >= S(c*) - epsilon and, for every dimension j, MAXIMIZE dims satisfy v_j(c) >= v_j(c*) - delta and MINIMIZE dims satisfy v_j(c) <= v_j(c*) + delta}
selectionSemantics.nonDominatedBand: every band member is non-dominated by construction because V is a subset of F
selectionSemantics.deltaProtection: a candidate more than delta away from c* in the worse direction of any dimension is excluded from V even when its score is within epsilon; the worse direction is below for MAXIMIZE and above for MINIMIZE

pipeline.rule: Exclusion reasons are computed for every frozen candidate (non-empty legalityFlags maps to its codes; actorStatus DISABLED or TERMINAL maps to ACTOR_DISABLED or ACTOR_TERMINAL; targetCount < 1 maps to TARGET_EMPTY). Excluded candidates retain full S1-S6 vector coverage and their exclusion reason in the decision record; they never enter Pareto and never disappear.
Compute S1-S6 for every candidate in L and for every excluded candidate (coverage). Complete evaluation; no candidate reduction, no Top-K, no sampling before this stage.
Exact nondominated frontier F over L and the six policy dimensions (direction-aware). Dominated candidates are never selected. Exact-duplicate vectors form one class.
Weights w(e) by the closed form in weights; normalize to sum 1.

S(c) = sum_j w_j * v_j(c) with v_j in NORMALIZED_0_1; non-finite any value is FATAL before ranking. Dimension direction is consumed by Pareto dominance (stage 3) and delta protection (stage 6); the score itself is a plain weighted sum of the frozen normalized components.
c* = argmax S with margin m; m > epsilon implies V = {c*}; otherwise V per selectionSemantics.equivalenceBand with per-dimension delta protection.

If |V| >= 2: order V by candidateId UTF-16 code unit ascending; mass(c) = (S(c) - min_V S + rho)^kappa; non-finite or non-positive total mass is FATAL; P(c) = mass(c) / sum over V of mass; consume the declared seededRandomFact (seed 64 hex, actualValue in [0,1)); pick the first candidate whose cumulative P strictly exceeds actualValue; the last candidate in the ordering absorbs any residual floating-point error; record distribution, actualValue and outcomeBranch.
Exact-duplicate vector classes and equal-P candidates resolve by candidateId UTF-16 code unit ascending; the draw never splits duplicate classes.

protections.clearOptimalProtection: margin m > epsilon forces V = {c*} and a deterministic pick without consuming any random fact
protections.bandBounded: selected candidate is within epsilon of the best experience score and within delta of c* in every normalized dimension

randomFact.seed: seed is a 64-hex identifier declared by upstream as part of the fact; the provider never recomputes, re-derives or hashes it
randomFact.actualValue: actualValue in [0,1) is declared by upstream as the realized value of the fact; the provider consumes it directly in the inverse CDF draw
randomFact.consumptionRule: A declared random fact is consumed only when |V| >= 2; |V| = 1 selects deterministically and consumes no fact
randomFact.replayRule: Declaring the same seed and actualValue reproduces the same distribution, the same pick and the same outcomeBranch.

stateBoundary.activationRule: R9_ACTIVE only after M7 and every mandatory gate are accepted; M2 keeps the provider candidate-only.

complexity.note: D = 6 policy dimensions is a constant, so the expression simplifies to O(C^2 + C(F+T+P+K)); the derivation keeps D explicit.

terms.T: target legality and constraint checks per candidate

selfConsistency: components contains exactly S1..S6 with unique codes.
Every component policyDimension exists in SelectionPolicyV1 paretoDimensions.
Every component causalOwner is one of STATE_DELTA, ACTION_POOL_DELTA, TERMINAL_DELTA, NONE.
Every component formula references only columns in immediateMechanicalColumns and constants.
Constants satisfy 0 < epsilon <= 1, 0 < delta <= 1, kappa >= 1, rho > 0, capS4 > 0, refSpread > 0.
base weights sum to 1 and all influence constants are non-negative.
Pipeline stages are exactly 1..8 in order.
stateBoundary states match ExecutionContractV31 providerStateMachine states and selectionScope maps 1:1 to stateBoundary.selection values.
The score is a plain weighted sum of frozen normalized components; component direction is consumed by Pareto dominance and delta protection only.
The seeded draw consumes only the declared actualValue; the provider never calls Math.random, Date.now or process.hrtime and never recomputes the seed.
A declared random fact is consumed only when |V| >= 2; |V| = 1 consumes no fact.
The draw picks the first candidate whose cumulative probability strictly exceeds actualValue; the last candidate absorbs residual floating-point error.
inputSurface.forbidden names are disjoint from inputSurface.allowed names.
